bounded_memory.principle: Every measured mutable controller component must stay within its byte cap.

controller_controls.principle: Transaction, leakage, admission, shuffle, reload, and rollback controls must pass.

development_rule_sealed.principle: Only eight development public streams choose one fixed coverage rule.

effective_shuffle_diagnostic.principle: A distinguishable eligible diagnostic must change the selected snapshot identity.

eight_arm_rows.principle: Every selected independent stream must have all eight arm rows.

independent_raw_reducer.principle: A cold raw-row reduction must reproduce every producer unit row.

science_learning_gain.principle: This phase builds a fixture and does not score learning gain.

sealed_streams.principle: All separated development and prospective files must be immutable and conformant.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List only models invoked now; this CPU task invokes none.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Keep each frozen criterion, observed value, and pass state.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC end time.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: Released feedback changes reusable finite constraints, not model weights.
field_principles.controller_contract: Freeze signature distance, admission, capacity, safety, query, and byte caps.
field_principles.coverage_fixture_ready_score: One certifies runnable controls, sealed streams, and bounded memory.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time with disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_host: Record the real hostname separately from venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host for orchestration and name boards only in separate receipts.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind this evidence to the fixed Exp7253 task.
field_principles.field_principles: Keep explanations here and ordinary values at top level.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name the exact failed external check for every blocked result.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ for measured findings and blocked_ for external absence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe the CPU exact solver or a blocked no-run state.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the closed compute class without padding duration.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive this value from current calls, not historical evidence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record observed source, ownership, hash, import, and quarantine checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, prospective, shuffle, delay, and query seeds.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, inputs, configuration, raw rows, and result fields.
field_principles.rows: Retain every independent stream and arm summary with full denominators.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260912 and keep actual UTC timestamps separately.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: State planned, attempted, completed, censored units, and stopping.
field_principles.schema: Version this artifact and keep experiment identity as ordinary fields.
field_principles.shuffle_effect_receipt: Show an identity-changing mapping under the same archive and safety gate.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact upstream and local source bytes.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start time.
field_principles.status: A terminal artifact is complete or blocked; checkpoints remain in progress.
field_principles.stream_manifest: Hash development, prospective public, release, and private authority bytes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record commands, exit codes, classifications, and log hashes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict class and forbid a positive oracle claim.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose that the exact evaluator also defines correctness.

honest_verdict: complete_circular_positive: bounded coverage fixture and effective controls are ready

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: all predeclared streams once; no outcome-based extension
